causalAutopsy.notes: Latent since #2155 introduced the canary. The executor s own check runs were given VITEST_CACHE_DIR/ESBUILD_CACHE_DIR, but runRunnerCanary was not, so the base-unit-smoke probe could never pass from an attempt workspace under the agent home. It never surfaced because the canary had never actually run in production: every attempt stopped earlier at deps-unavailable (fixed separately in #2259). Found by pre-verifying the canary before spending an executor start, specifically because a canary failure latches for 24h with no route to clear it.
